_comment: ATC reply phraseology. Templates use {placeholders} filled by the brain. Edit wording here to match a community's SOP (e.g. Master Arms) without touching Python. Logic (which call triggers which template) lives in brain.py.

templates.taxi: {callsign}, {ground}, cleared taxi {taxi_route} and hold short runway {runway}.
templates.lineup_readback_straight: {callsign}, {tower}, fly runway heading, cleared for takeoff runway {runway}.
templates.tower_continue_entry: {callsign}, {tower}, roger, continue to {gate}, report runway in sight.
templates.tower_position_bra_challenge: {callsign}, {tower}, negative. I show you {point} {bearing} for {range}, angels {actual_angels}. Confirm your position.
templates.ground_info_weather: {callsign}, {ground}, weather is {weather}. Wind {wind}, runway {runway} in use, QNH {qnh}.
templates.ground_info_readback: {callsign}, {ground}, readback correct, advise when ready for clearance.
templates.readback_incomplete: {callsign}, {agency}, readback incomplete, I did not get your {item}. Continue.
templates.inbound_outside: {callsign}, {tower}, roger, report entering the control zone, runway {runway} active.
templates.inbound_inside: {callsign}, {tower}, radar contact {position}, cleared control zone entry, join {downwind} downwind runway {runway}.
templates.inbound_via_gate: {callsign}, {tower}, roger, report entering the control zone via {gate}, runway {runway} active.
templates.arrival_wrong_call: {callsign}, {tower}, negative, report runway in sight for landing.
templates.cleared_overhead: {flight}{callsign}, {tower}, wind {wind}, cleared for {downwind} overhead break runway {runway}.
templates.exit_deviation: {callsign}, {tower}, you did not exit through {assigned_gate}; continue as cleared.
templates.control_join: {callsign}, {control}, radar contact, turn {turn} heading {heading} to join via {gate}.
templates.control_join_straight: {callsign}, {control}, radar contact, fly heading {heading} to join via {gate}.
templates.control_join_requested: {callsign}, {control}, approved, turn {turn} heading {heading} to join via {gate}.
templates.control_join_requested_straight: {callsign}, {control}, approved, fly heading {heading} to join via {gate}.
templates.control_too_early: {callsign}, {control}, roger, remain below {altitude} until clear of the control zone via {gate}.
templates.go_around_traffic: {callsign}, {tower}, go around, traffic on the runway.
templates.go_around_ack: {callsign}, {tower}, roger, continue climbing and rejoin {downwind} downwind for runway {runway}.
templates.altitude_bust: {callsign}, {tower}, you are leaving the control zone, contact {control} on channel {channel}.
templates.runway_incursion: {callsign}, {tower}, you are on the runway without clearance, vacate immediately.
templates.ctr_warning: {callsign}, {agency}, you are entering controlled airspace without clearance. Squawk {squawk} and state intentions.
templates.state_reset: {callsign}, {agency}, state reset. Contact {ground} on channel {ground_channel} when ready.
templates.position_challenge: {callsign}, {agency}, negative. I show you {position}. Confirm your position.
templates.speed_restriction_ctr: {callsign}, {agency}, maintain {speed} knots or less inside the control zone.
templates.speed_restriction_none: {callsign}, {agency}, no additional speed restriction assigned in this control zone.
templates.speed_restriction_outside: {callsign}, {agency}, no additional speed restriction assigned outside the control zone.
templates.speed_position_unknown: {callsign}, {agency}, unable to confirm your position. State your position.
templates.help_idle: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: contact {ground} on channel {ground_channel} for clearance and taxi, then {tower} on channel {tower_channel} for takeoff.
templates.help_clearance: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: read back your clearance, then request taxi.
templates.help_taxi: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: taxi to runway {runway} via {taxi_route}, then report holding short of runway {runway}.
templates.help_holding: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: you are holding short. Contact {tower} on channel {tower_channel} and report ready for departure.
templates.help_lineup: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: you are cleared to line up and wait runway {runway}. Read back 'line up and wait', or report ready for departure, to get your takeoff clearance.
templates.help_departure: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: you are cleared for takeoff runway {runway}. After departure turn {turn} {gate}, {altitude} or below, then contact {control} on channel {channel}.
templates.help_airborne: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: contact {control} on channel {channel} and report your position and intentions.
templates.help_airborne_on_control: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: report inbound when you turn back, or push Stingray on channel {stingray_channel} once you are at Angels 15.
templates.help_inbound: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: report entering the control zone, then report runway in sight.
templates.help_landing: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: runway {runway} is active. Optional: in the break, turning final. Report on final for landing clearance.
templates.help_escape: Say reset to start over, or cancel to undo a clearance.
templates.trainer_echo_on: {callsign}, {agency}, trainer echo on. I will echo our exchanges to your in-game message feed.
templates.trainer_mode_coach: {callsign}, {agency}, trainer coach mode. I will suggest the better call when your wording is off.
templates.trainer_mode_casual: {callsign}, {agency}, trainer casual mode. Relaxed: I will not comment on wording.
templates.trainer_unknown: {callsign}, {agency}, trainer commands: coach mode, casual mode, echo on, echo off, volume 0.3.
templates.stingray_bullseye_challenge: {callsign}, {stingray}, negative. I show you {point} {bearing} for {range}, angels {actual_angels}. Confirm your position.
templates.stingray_angels_rounding: {callsign}, {stingray}, negative. State angels as a whole thousand — angels {angels}.
templates.stingray_angels_and_position: {callsign}, {stingray}, negative. State angels as a whole thousand — angels {angels} — and I show you {point} {bearing} for {range}. Confirm your position.
templates.authentication_not_implemented: {callsign}, {agency}, authentication is not implemented in this trainer. Continue as fragged.
templates.capability_not_implemented: {callsign}, {agency}, {capability} is not implemented in this trainer. Continue as fragged.
templates.emergency_not_implemented: {callsign}, {agency}, copy your emergency. Emergency handling is not implemented in this trainer. Continue as fragged.
templates.help_stingray: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: you are with Stingray. Give a bullseye picture — you are {bullseye} — then "as fragged". To head home, call "bugout" (or bingo / Miller Time / requesting RTB). Stingray will push Control between 25 and 80 miles from Kutaisi; if you have not heard the push by 25 miles, request Control on channel {channel}.
templates.help_stingray_nobullseye: {callsign}, {help_prefix}: you are with Stingray. Give a bullseye picture ("bullseye 065 for 40, Angels 15, as fragged"). To head home, call "bugout" (or bingo / Miller Time / requesting RTB). Stingray will push Control between 25 and 80 miles from Kutaisi; if you have not heard the push by 25 miles, request Control on channel {channel}.
